propositions.name: simultaneity_at_distant_points
propositions.statement: The phrase 'the same instant' picks out one definite instant that applies to two spatially separate points on a beam of light.
propositions.quote: if the distance between the points is a multiple of a wave-length the same process is going on at the two points at the same instant

propositions.name: opposite_process_at_same_instant
propositions.statement: The processes going on in two separated portions of a beam are exactly opposite at one common instant of time.
propositions.quote: the process going on in the first portion of light being always the exact opposite of the process going on in the other at the same instant

propositions.name: universal_time_parameter
propositions.statement: A single time t and a single distance x measured from a fixed point suffice to describe the phase of the process at any point in the beam.
propositions.quote: which gives u , the phase of the process, at a point whose distance measured from a fixed point in the beam is x , and at a time t

propositions.name: aether_is_frame_of_rest
propositions.statement: There is a definite fact of the matter about whether dense bodies are in motion through the aether or carry it along with them.
propositions.quote: we have next to inquire whether, when these dense bodies are in motion through the great ocean of aether, they carry along with them the aether they contain

propositions.name: velocity_of_aether_relative_to_stations
propositions.statement: Comparing observed light velocities in opposite directions along the earth's surface would yield the velocity of the aether with respect to those terrestrial stations.
propositions.quote: by comparing the observed velocities in opposite directions, determine the velocity of the aether with respect to these terrestrial stations

propositions.name: round_trip_time_shifted_by_aether
propositions.statement: A relative velocity of the aether equal to the earth's orbital velocity would increase the round-trip transmission time by a definite fraction of order one hundred millionth.
propositions.quote: the increase of this time on account of a relative velocity of the aether equal to that of the earth in its orbit would be only about one hundred millionth part of the whole time of transmission

propositions.name: direction_of_ray_in_space
propositions.statement: A ray of light has a definite direction in space, independent of the apparatus that carries it.
propositions.quote: obtained what he supposed to be evidence of a difference in the result when the direction of the ray in space was different

propositions.name: earths_orbital_motion_is_absolute
propositions.statement: The earth has a definite direction of motion in its orbit that can be lined up with the direction of a light ray inside an apparatus.
propositions.quote: The apparatus was first turned so that the direction of the light in first passing through the second prism was that of the earth's motion in its orbit

propositions.name: aether_velocity_relative_to_solar_system
propositions.statement: There is a definite relative velocity of the aether with respect to the solar system that observation could in principle determine.
propositions.quote: The only practicable method of determining directly the relative velocity of the aether with respect to the solar system is to compare the values of the velocity of light

propositions.name: light_speed_composes_with_water_speed
propositions.statement: The velocity of light in a stream of water differs in the direction the water moves versus the opposite direction, so light velocity combines with the medium's velocity.
propositions.quote: he has observed that the propagation of light in a stream of water takes place with greater velocity in the direction in which the water moves than in the opposite direction

propositions.name: two_bodies_cannot_annihilate
propositions.statement: Two material bodies put together cannot annihilate each other, so darkness produced by combining two portions of light shows light is not a substance.
propositions.quote: we cannot suppose that two bodies when put together can annihilate each other; therefore light cannot be a substance

propositions.name: light_is_a_process_in_a_substance
propositions.statement: Light is not itself a substance but a process going on in some other substance that carries it.
propositions.quote: We therefore conclude that light is not a substance but a process going on in a substance

propositions.name: light_has_definite_propagation_velocity
propositions.statement: Light is propagated with a certain definite velocity, given as 3.004 x 10 centimetres per second in vacuum.
propositions.quote: Now, light is known to be propagated with a certain velocity (3.004 x 10 centimetres per second in vacuum, according to Cornu)

propositions.name: energy_resides_in_medium_during_transit
propositions.statement: Radiant energy is not transmitted instantaneously from radiating to absorbing body but exists for a certain time in the intervening medium.
propositions.quote: In the next place this energy is not transmitted instantaneously from the radiating body to the absorbing body, but exists for a certain time in the medium

propositions.name: aether_has_elasticity_and_finite_density
propositions.statement: The aether possesses elasticity similar to that of a solid body and has a finite density.
propositions.quote: We must therefore regard the aether as possessing elasticity similar to that of a solid body, and also as having a finite density

propositions.name: aether_interpenetrates_gross_matter
propositions.statement: The luminiferous medium is distinct from ordinary transparent matter yet interpenetrates all transparent bodies and probably opaque ones too.
propositions.quote: something distinct from the transparent medium known to us, though it interpenetrates all transparent bodies and probably opaque bodies too

propositions.name: vibration_vector_transverse_to_ray
propositions.statement: The physical process of light propagation is a vector at right angles to the ray, either in the plane of polarization or perpendicular to it.
propositions.quote: this vector must be at right angles to the ray, and either in the plane of polarization or perpendicular to it

propositions.name: path_difference_measured_in_wavelengths
propositions.statement: Extinction of light occurs when the difference of the two path lengths is an odd multiple of a definite half wave-length distance.
propositions.quote: the light is extinguished when the difference of the length of the paths is an odd multiple of a certain small distance called a half wave-length

propositions.name: air_cannot_transmit_transverse_vibrations
propositions.statement: Air cannot transmit transverse vibrations, and the normal vibrations it does transmit travel about a million times slower than light.
propositions.quote: the air cannot transmit transverse vibrations, and the normal vibrations which the air does transmit travel about a million times slower than light

propositions.name: electromagnetic_and_light_media_identical
propositions.statement: If the calculated velocity of an electromagnetic disturbance equals the velocity of light, the two media occupying the same space are really identical.
propositions.quote: If this should be equal to the velocity of light, we would have strong reason to believe that the two media, occupying as they do the same space, are really identical

propositions.name: inductive_capacity_equals_index_squared
propositions.statement: In non-magnetic media the specific inductive capacity should equal the square of the index of refraction if light is an electromagnetic disturbance.
propositions.quote: then in non-magnetic media the specific inductive capacity should be equal to the square of the index of refraction

propositions.name: polarization_planes_have_definite_angle
propositions.statement: There is a definite angle between the planes of polarization of two rays that determines whether interference is visible on the screen.
propositions.quote: when the planes of polarization are at right angles, the illumination of the screen becomes uniform, and no trace of interference can be discovered

propositions.name: rotation_localized_about_own_axis
propositions.statement: Any motion of rotation in the magnetized medium must be a rotation of very small portions of the medium each about its own axis.
propositions.quote: If there is any motion of rotation, it must be a rotation of very small portions of the medium each about its own axis, so that the medium must be broken up into a number of molecular vortices

propositions.name: vortex_motion_without_dissipation
propositions.statement: The molecular vortices in the aether can maintain their motion indefinitely without requiring continual work or dissipating energy into heat.
propositions.quote: we conclude that the molecular vortices do not require a continual expenditure of work in order to maintain their motion, and that therefore this motion does not necessarily involve dissipation of energy

propositions.name: interplanetary_space_not_empty
propositions.statement: Interplanetary and interstellar spaces are not empty but occupied by a material substance that is the largest and most uniform body we know.
propositions.quote: there can be no doubt that the interplanetary and interstellar spaces are not empty, but are occupied by a material substance or body, which is certainly the largest

propositions.name: aether_isotropic_and_homogeneous
propositions.statement: The aether that fills interplanetary and interstellar space forms a vast homogeneous expanse of isotropic matter.
propositions.quote: Whether this vast homogeneous expanse of isotropic matter is fitted not only to be a medium of physical interaction between distant bodies

propositions.name: energy_of_radiation_measurable_by_heating
propositions.statement: The energy of radiation can be calculated by measuring the heat it communicates to bodies that absorb it.
propositions.quote: by measuring the heat communicated to such bodies, the energy of the radiation may be calculated

propositions.name: phase_expressible_as_cosine_of_nt_minus_px
propositions.statement: The phase of the light process at every point and time can be summed up in the expression u = A cos(nt - px + a).
propositions.quote:
These phenomena may be summed up in the mathematical expression 
	u = A cos(nt - px + a)

propositions.name: moving_point_sees_same_process
propositions.statement: A point moving along the ray with the velocity of light would find the same process going on at every point of the ray as it reaches it.
propositions.quote: if we suppose a movable point to travel along the ray with this velocity, we shall find the same process going on at every point of the ray as the moving point reaches it

propositions.name: process_reversible_in_sign
propositions.statement: The physical quantity that propagates as light is capable of assuming negative as well as positive values, so that one portion can be the exact opposite of another.
propositions.quote: any physical quantity which is capable of assuming negative as well as positive values

propositions.name: gross_particles_vibrate_with_aether
propositions.statement: In transparent media the particles of gross matter vibrate along with those of the aether, taking some part in the process of light propagation.
propositions.quote: we must therefore suppose that these media take some part in the process, and that their particles are vibrating as well as those of the aether
